title: 概率重校准预注册：Track A + Track B 输出校准；Track C 无 PIT 数据取消
summary_zh: 诊断已确认 MODEL_BIAS_SUPPORTED（模型概率系统性偏高、越自信越离谱）。Track A 仅作为 total 的离线候选，home advantage 沿用已验证的生产值 0.30；Track B 现按本次预注册进行 TRAIN-only 的 market×selection 分层层级 isotonic，并与 selection-aware Platt baseline 做时间 OOF 选择。Track C 因无逐场 PIT Elo/身价数据取消。所有候选不上线、不推荐，前瞻 holdout/test 仍是独立的一次性验收。

amendment_log.changed: home_advantage_goals and league_home_advantage moved to unchanged; Track A fits only total_scale and league_total_scale; production home advantage remains 0.30
amendment_log.evidence: calibration_validation_ledger.v1 V1-HOME-ADVANTAGE-RECALIBRATION-01: 10-fold OOF plus 2,000 bootstrap, APPROVED_VALIDATED

amendment_log.changed: Track A optimizer parameter vector reduced to total-only hierarchical projected diagonal-Newton with fixed lambda_reg_total=5.0 and backtracking
amendment_log.evidence: prior zero-OOF home-advantage single-split fit was lower evidence grade than the validated 0.30 ledger value

amendment_log.changed: added fixed 4-fold expanding-window rolling-origin OOF diagnostics for raw versus candidate mean NLL, total absolute gap, and 1X2 multiclass Brier
amendment_log.evidence: pre-registered before rerun; OOF is TRAIN-only and cannot select or alter parameters

amendment_log.changed: added raw uncalibrated baseline metrics to the existing four market×selection OOF rows without changing family, k, min_cell, binning, or selection rules
amendment_log.evidence: same expanding-time OOF folds as the existing candidate comparison

amendment_log.changed: added exclusion counts, reasons, and fixture IDs for 26 rows/13 fixtures; admission rules unchanged
amendment_log.evidence: frozen TRAIN CSV inspection found all 26 rows lacking model_settlement_distribution

amendment_log.changed: corrected report hash anchor and replaced the Dixon-Coles rationale with the verified production no-op rho=0.0 statement
amendment_log.evidence: shasum -a 256 of every referenced local input and production calibration ledger params

amendment_log.changed: Track A artifact is archived as REJECTED_BY_TRAIN_OOF_SCORELINE_NLL; no holdout opening and no further refit
amendment_log.evidence: TRAIN-only expanding-window OOF candidate mean_nll=2.973974352639 exceeded raw mean_nll=2.973314433300 in all three scored folds, violating track_a_primary.scoreline_nll.required

amendment_log.changed: Track B candidate family pool now includes raw identity alongside hierarchical_isotonic and platt; selection rule, k, min_cell_n, binning, and OOF folds unchanged
amendment_log.evidence: TRAIN-only OOF rerun; raw is an explicit恒等映射 baseline and does not alter the preregistered Brier then NLL then fixed-name rule

amendment_log.changed: added frozen stopping rule: if any major market×selection cell n>=50 has abs(selected TRAIN OOF cal_gap)>0.05, terminate Track B after two iterations and forbid a third iteration or further family/parameter amendment
amendment_log.evidence: TRAIN-only OOF stopping gate pre-registered before any holdout/test access

authority_boundary.authorized_now: offline fitting of Track A and Track B candidates only; Track C cancelled

totals_mapping_no_bug.code: settlement_distribution_totals and settlement_distribution_ah integrate the same score_matrix symmetrically

bias_by_league.note: 法甲、英冠为负偏差（模型低估），禁止全局一刀切压低

total_underestimate.interpretation: 模型总进球水平系统性偏低，且分联赛异质（德甲最严重）

prior_v1_slope_rejected.result: raw_delta_scale=1.102038 REJECTED by OOF gate (95% CI upper bound > 0)
prior_v1_slope_rejected.lesson: 单一全局 scale 缩放被证伪；本协议 total 拟合必须 per-league + shrinkage

prior_193_fitted_model.result: 五大 Understat 离线拟合 lambda ~0.99 稳健，但市场基准 eval 裁决模型相对 Pinnacle 收盘负增量，未接 champion；降级为分歧雷达 FITTED_CALIBRATED
prior_193_fitted_model.lesson: #193 方法论（离线拟合 lambda + walk-forward + challenger）可复用，但需扩联赛、换目标指标（正向结算概率校准）、分联赛分层

diagnostic_1394.source: dynamic_prematch_evaluations 全量去重，kickoff 截至 2026-09-22

rebuildable_historical_pit.source: 当前可重建历史 PIT；按当前 enabled competition、严格赛前至少 5 场历史重建；实际数量与 fixture identity digest 写入拟合 artifact
rebuildable_historical_pit.prior_reference: 历史 8,659 场仅保留为已披露诊断背景，不再作为精确 TRAIN identity 硬锁
rebuildable_historical_pit.no_count_backfill: 不得为凑固定数量而截断、插补或删除 fixture

contamination_disclosure.rule: 任何出现在上述两个集合的 fixture 不得进入 validation 或 test，无论后续如何重抽取或身份拼写。

track_a_root_fix_total.goal: 治本：修正模型 total(λh+λa) 的系统性偏低；home advantage 固定沿用已验证的生产值
track_a_root_fix_total.hypothesis: 模型 total 由 base_home+base_away（xG 攻守平均纯量）构成且无额外校准，系统性低于真实总进球，分联赛异质

parameterization.shrinkage: league_total_scale 向 total_scale 收缩（见 shrinkage_contract）

track_a_root_fix_total.candidate_formula: total_calibrated = clamp(total * total_scale * league_total_scale[league], 1.35, 4.40); delta/home advantage path unchanged at production home_advantage_goals=0.30; lambda_home/lambda_away use unchanged production delta path
unchanged: delta 路径的 elo_gap_weight / squad_value_log_weight / lineup 项（Elo/身价缺失时保持生产语义 0）

track_b_output_calibration.goal: 治标：对模型正向结算概率做分层输出校准，比较层级 isotonic 与 selection-aware Platt
track_b_output_calibration.calibration_target: 模型正向结算概率 P(WIN)+P(HALF_WIN) -> 校准后正向结算概率
track_b_output_calibration.function: 层级 isotonic 单调非递减 + 连续 shrinkage；selection-aware Platt 作为低方差 baseline
track_b_output_calibration.rationale: 偏差单调且方向依赖 selection（UNDER 严重高估、OVER 基本准、AH 两方向居中），全局单函数会混叠；UNDER/OVER 必须分开

track_c_root_fix_delta.cancellation_reason: Elo 仅 242 条静态快照、无逐场 PIT；身价逐场 PIT artifact 为 0，无法识别 elo_gap_weight / squad_value_log_weight。
track_c_root_fix_delta.retained_diagnosis: Elo/身价可能解释部分 delta 偏差，但在缺少逐场 PIT 特征时不可估计；不得创建候选参数或待上线缺口。

track_relationship.order: 本轮离线启动 Track A 与 Track B；Track C=CANCELLED_NO_PIT_DATA；两轨候选分别验收，不互相替代
track_relationship.independence: Track A 单独验收并有失败回退；不得用已取消 Track C 或未启动 Track B 掩盖 Track A 失败
track_relationship.forbidden: 不得以 Track B 的 isotonic 校准结果反向声称 Track A 参数已修复；不得用 Track A 拟合内 NLL 替代前瞻 holdout 验收

league_home_advantage.source: production delta path; not fitted in this amendment

track_a_fit_method.objective: fixture-level Poisson negative log likelihood of the observed scoreline under unchanged production lambda clamps; production dixon_coles_rho=0.0 so the Dixon-Coles path is a no-op
track_a_fit_method.optimizer: projected diagonal-Newton updates with closed bounds and backtracking line search; stop on objective tolerance
track_a_fit_method.precision: store at 6 decimal places; code uses exactly the stored decimal

track_b_fit_method.function: hierarchical PAVA isotonic with right-edge block thresholds; selection-aware Platt logistic baseline
track_b_fit_method.global_prior: market x selection (OVER, UNDER, HOME, AWAY are independent)
track_b_fit_method.pava_threshold_contract: each fitted block is serialized with right_edge=max(x), never mean(x); prediction uses the block containing x
track_b_fit_method.continuous_shrinkage: w = n/(n+k) for every cell, k=20; p_cal=w*p_cell+(1-w)*p_market_selection_global
track_b_fit_method.oof_selection: expanding-time OOF within each market x selection over raw, hierarchical_isotonic, and platt; choose lowest Brier, then NLL, then fixed name tie-break
track_b_fit_method.raw_baseline_reporting: raw is now a candidate family and is also reported in the four market x selection OOF rows
track_b_fit_method.holdout_rule: selected family and parameters are frozen before any holdout/test access; holdout/test are not read during fitting

stopping_rule.condition: 若 Track B v2 在 TRAIN OOF 上仍有任一主要格（n>=50）abs(cal_gap)>0.05

track_a.mechanism: hierarchical ridge: league_total_scale shrinks toward total_scale；home advantage remains fixed at production 0.30；penalty lambda_reg_total=5.0
track_a.effect: 小联赛样本少时 total 分层参数自动靠近全局参数，防过拟合

track_b.mechanism: per-competition isotonic shrinks toward the matching market x selection global isotonic; selection-aware Platt is a preregistered baseline
track_b.weight: w = n / (n + k), k = 20, applied continuously for every n
track_b.effect: 消除 n=20 结构跳变，且不让 UNDER 的先验污染 OVER；OOF 只用于 family selection，不查看 holdout

track_c.effect: 仅保留取消原因与历史诊断，不保留待拟合缺口

shrinkage_contract.no_post_hoc_tuning: lambda_reg 与 k 均为预注册固定值，拟合后不得因结果调整

universe.competitions: 生产 enabled 联赛在 fixture kickoff 时解析出的确切集合，冻结 ID 于抽取 artifact
universe.completion: 权威 FT 结果，明确 home/away 进球
universe.duplicate_rule: 每 fixture 一行；身份冲突 fail-closed

train.identity: 诊断 1,394 条 + 当前可重建历史 PIT（仅作 TRAIN，禁验证；实际计数与 fixture identity digest 以拟合 artifact 为准）
train.role: 拟合 Track A 参数与 Track B 输出校准候选；仅 TRAIN，不承担 validation/test 接受

validation.selection: kickoff_at > T0 的前瞻 1,000 个 eligible fixture（升序），排除全部已披露历史 fixture
validation.role: 一次性 go/no-go 验证，绝不用作参数/阈值选择
validation.look_rule: outcome 与 metric 密封，直至 validation 与 test 共 2,000 条全部 eligible

test.selection: validation 之后紧接的 1,000 个 eligible fixture（升序）
test.look_rule: validation 通过且保持不变后，且 validation + test 共 2,000 条全部 eligible，才可打开

cross_split_rules: 一个 fixture 只属于一个 split
不得在观察到计数或 metric 后移除任何联赛/赛季/方向
PIT 输入缺失 = 在 outcome 访问前记录原因的排除，绝不以后来数据插补
validation/test 边界由 eligible fixture 顺序决定，不由 metric 值决定

calibration_gap_reduction.definition: 前瞻 holdout 上 candidate calibration gap 减 baseline calibration gap；按预注册方向定义为 absolute gap reduction = |gap_baseline| - |gap_candidate|
calibration_gap_reduction.required: fixture-bootstrap 95% CI 完全高于 0（CI 不含 0）

brier_not_worse.definition: candidate 正向结算二值 Brier - BASELINE_PRIOR Brier

candidate_primary.validation_then_test: 先在 1,000 条 validation 上做 go/no-go；validation 通过且冻结不变后，才打开紧接的 1,000 条 test

total_calibration.definition: 前瞻 validation 上 |mean(model_total_calibrated) - mean(actual_total)|，全局与分联赛（n>=20）分别报告
total_calibration.required: 全局绝对偏差 <= 0.10；分联赛绝对偏差中位数 <= 0.15

scoreline_nll.definition: Dixon-Coles 泊松比分 NLL，候选 vs BASELINE_PRIOR
scoreline_nll.required: candidate NLL < baseline NLL，且 fixture-bootstrap 95% CI 不含 0

brier_not_worse.definition: 正向结算二值 Brier，候选 vs BASELINE_PRIOR

track_a_primary.role: candidate_primary 之外的结构性诊断，不替代前瞻 gap reduction gate

calibration_gap.definition: 分层（league x market x selection）的模型正向概率 vs 实际正向率校准差

brier_not_worse.definition: 校准后正向二值 Brier vs 原始

track_b_primary.role: 本轮仅产出 TRAIN-only 离线候选；不打开 holdout/test，不注册、不上线

failure_and_rollback_rules.before_look: 只报告 eligible 计数与排除原因，不计算或暴露 validation/test metric
on_track_a_validation_failure: 回退 BASELINE_PRIOR，报告失败并停止
新假设需新预注册 + 全新 cohort
on_track_b_validation_failure: 不改分桶/删联赛/改阈值/缩样本
failure_and_rollback_rules.on_test_failure: no grant / no deployment / no reinterpretation of secondary metrics / report and stop
failure_and_rollback_rules.on_test_pass: 准备 APPROVED_VALIDATED 注册提案；注册与部署仍是独立的 Owner 授权动作
forbidden_post_hoc: 看结果后切换参数化（total_scale vs total_offset）

identity_contract.calibration_version: Track A 或 Track B 任一导致 lambda 公式或概率输出变化时，必须递增 calibration_version；Track C 已取消
identity_contract.params_snapshot: Track A candidate snapshot contains total_scale / league_total_scale; home_advantage_goals and league_home_advantage remain unchanged production fields; Track C parameters remain cancelled
identity_contract.safety_property: 任何公式版本或参数变化产生不同 calibration identity；旧 BASELINE_PRIOR 授权不得前向继承
identity_contract.grant_rule: validation 与 test 均通过且不可变证据 digest 齐备后，才可 ledger 注册

safety_invariants: 不碰 Provider allowlist / 配额 / 并发 / 重试
不碰推荐 / 结算 / 因子安全门
不改生产，零 enable / 零部署
raw payload / header / key 不提交
